description: Portrait of O'Keeffe rowing on the river; three quarter length view with O'Keeffe sitting in a boat,  both arms stretched out,  her hands actively gripping an oar; her body is facing the viewer right while her head is facing viewer left, she looks down in the direction of her oar engaged in the act of rowing, she wear a bandana on her head; a jean jacket, and jeans rolled up to her knee, to the right is a partial view of an man's back and forearm with his sleeve rolled up to his elbow
title: Georgia O'Keeffe at Glen Canyon
